d46bade4.yl: Yield: 28 portions of 50 g · Portion: 50 g
c: Soak beans 12 h; boil 5 min, drain (removes bitterness, shibukiri); repeat once.
Simmer in fresh water 60–80 min until crushable between fingers; keep beans covered.
Tsubu-an: drain, add sugar in 3 additions over low heat, stirring until a spoon line holds 2 s.
Koshi-an: press cooked beans through a fine sieve, wash, squeeze pulp in muslin; cook with sugar the same way.
Add salt and glucose at the end; spread thin on a tray to cool fast; cover with film.
d46bade4.st: Chill 0–4 °C, 5 days; freeze 2 months in 500 g bags.

c: Whisk flour and water smooth; add sugar.
Steam 25 min, stirring with a wet spatula every 8 min (or microwave 600 W 2 + 2 + 1 min, stirring) until translucent and elastic.
Knead hot in the bowl 2 min with a wet spatula to build stretch.
Turn onto a starch-dusted tray; dust top; cool 10 min.
Divide 30 g pieces; flatten to 8 cm; brush off excess starch before wrapping fillings.
76df57ef.st: Same day at 18–22 °C, covered. Do not chill (hardens).
76df57ef.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Dusting starch: ~40 g stays on the dough.

c: Ceremonial grade = drinks and raw creams only; culinary (premium/ingredient) = baked goods, sponges, doughs.
Dosage by weight of mix: creams 1–1.5%, sponges 3–4% of flour, ganache 2–3%, ice cream 1.5–2%.
Always sift; pre-mix with sugar or a little warm liquid (60 °C max) to avoid lumps.
Heat and light turn matcha olive-brown: bake ≤ 170 °C, short bakes, cover finished products, store in the dark.
Acid dulls colour; pair with white chocolate, red bean, black sesame, yuzu, strawberry.
Open tins: airtight, 4 °C, used within 4 weeks; bring to room temperature before opening (condensation).
621ae777.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Reference card.

c: Melt cream cheese, butter and milk over a bain-marie until smooth; cool to 40 °C.
Whisk in yolks, then sifted flour and starch, then lemon juice; strain.
Whip whites with sugar to soft-medium peaks (bends at the tip, not stiff — stiff = cracks).
Fold into the base in 3 additions; pour into an 18 cm lined tin (paper collar 10 cm high).
Water bath: 150 °C 25 min, then 140 °C 50 min; leave in the oven with the door ajar 15 min.
Cool, chill 4 h; dust or glaze with apricot.
112cab72.st: Chill 0–4 °C covered; 2 days (cream cakes 2 days, sponges 3 days). Mochi/rice-flour items: same day at room temperature (they harden when chilled).
112cab72.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (egg yolks, egg whites) · 7 Milk (cream cheese, butter 82%, milk 3%).

c: Whip eggs and sugar warm (40 °C) to ribbon stage, 8 min.
Fold in sifted flour + matcha; temper milk + oil with a little batter, fold back in.
Spread on a lined tray; bake 180 °C 11 min; cool under a cloth.
Whisk matcha with sugar; whip with cream to firm peaks.
Spread cream on the sponge (thicker at the near edge); line anko 3 cm from the edge; roll tight in paper.
Chill seam-down 2 h; trim ends; cut 10 slices with a hot knife.
757a1fed.st: Chill 0–4 °C covered; 2 days (cream cakes 2 days, sponges 3 days). Mochi/rice-flour items: same day at room temperature (they harden when chilled).

c: Warm honey, glucose and milk to 40 °C.
Whip eggs and sugar at 40 °C to thick ribbon (12 min); add honey mix; whip slow 2 min.
Fold in sifted bread flour (gluten gives the classic chew); mix slow 2 min until glossy.
Line the frame with paper; scatter coarse sugar on the base; pour batter; pop bubbles with a skewer 3 times in the first 10 min.
Turn out top-down onto film; wrap while warm (moist crust); rest 12 h; trim sides, cut 16 slices.
333fc496.st: Wrapped at 18–22 °C, 4 days; best on day 2.

c: Mix to full gluten (window pane), butter last; DDT 26 °C; bulk 60 min.
Cream butter and sugar; add egg and zest; fold in flour; chill 30 min.
Roll 16 × 35 g discs; drape over each bun; dip top in sugar; score a lattice.
Proof 50 min at 28 °C (not humid); bake 180 °C 13 min.
e07684a9.st: Bake/steam same day. Cooled buns: freeze 4 weeks; re-steam 6 min or refresh 160 °C 4 min.
e07684a9.al: 1 Gluten (strong bread flour, wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter 82%).

c: Whisk eggs, sugar, honey, milk and oil; whisk in sifted flour + baking powder; rest 30 min.
Heat pan medium; fill each side 60% with batter; add 30 g anko on one side.
Close; cook 2–3 min per side to golden; trim edges; serve hot.
25a4dd60.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (milk 3%). Variation: custard (crème pât.) or matcha cream filling.

c: Dissolve starch and sugar in water; cook over medium heat stirring until it turns translucent and very elastic (3–4 min after it thickens).
Spread on a kinako-dusted tray; chill only 20 min in iced water bath (not the fridge); cut 2 cm cubes with a wet knife.
Roast soy flour dry until nutty if raw (kinako = roasted); mix with sugar.
Simmer kokuto and water 5 min to a light syrup; cool.
Toss cubes in kinako; serve 70 g with 15 ml kuromitsu.
620b6202.st: Same day at 18 °C; mochi turns white and hard below 10 °C.

c: Mix flours with water to an earlobe-soft dough; roll 15 g balls.
Boil until they float + 2 min; ice water 1 min; drain; skewer 3 per stick.
Char lightly on the grill or with a torch.
Bring soy, sugar, mirin and water to a simmer; thicken with starch slurry to a glossy coat.
Spoon 25 g over each skewer warm.
c6505c92.st: Serve same day; do not chill.

c: Whip eggs and sugar warm to firm ribbon; fold in sifted flour; fold in warm butter + milk.
Bake 170 °C 28 min; drop the tin once; cool upside down; split into 3 layers.
Brush layers with syrup; whip cream + sugar to medium (spreadable) peaks.
Layer sponge, cream, halved strawberries ×2; mask top and sides smooth.
Pipe rosettes; top with whole strawberries; chill 2 h; cut 12.
27c98c84.st: Chill 0–4 °C covered; 2 days (cream cakes 2 days, sponges 3 days). Mochi/rice-flour items: same day at room temperature (they harden when chilled).
27c98c84.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (butter 82%, milk 3%, cream 35%).

c: Mix to a smooth dough 8 min; proof 45 min until 1.5×.
Whisk everything except butter; steam in a tray 25 min, whisking every 5 min, until thick.
Beat in butter; chill until firm; portion 25 g balls.
Wrap filling, pleat or pinch closed, seam down on paper squares.
Proof 20 min; steam high 10 min; rest 2 min before opening the lid (prevents wrinkling).
1e64af22.st: Bake/steam same day. Cooled buns: freeze 4 weeks; re-steam 6 min or refresh 160 °C 4 min.
1e64af22.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, wheat starch) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, milk powder, butter 82%).

c: Mix to full gluten; bulk 60 min; divide 16 × 58 g; round; proof 45 min.
Cream butter and icing sugar; add yolk; fold in dry ingredients; chill 20 min.
Press 24 g discs over proofed buns; brush with egg yolk wash.
Bake 190 °C 15 min until the crust cracks and turns deep golden.
Split the warm bun; insert a 10 g slice of cold butter; serve at once.
1306b31a.st: Bake/steam same day. Cooled buns: freeze 4 weeks; re-steam 6 min or refresh 160 °C 4 min.
1306b31a.al: 1 Gluten (strong bread flour, wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs, egg yolks) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter 82%, milk powder).

c: Dissolve kansui in water (lye water); mix with golden syrup and oil; fold in flour to a soft dough.
Wrap; rest 4 h at room temperature (pliable, no shrinkage). Wear gloves with kansui.
Spray yolks with rice wine; bake 170 °C 6 min; cool.
Wrap each yolk in 63 g lotus paste (75 g balls); divide skin 25 g.
Flatten skin, wrap filling thinly and evenly; press in a floured mould.
Bake 180 °C 5 min; mist, cool 10 min; brush very thinly with yolk wash; bake 12 min more to golden.
Rest 2 days airtight (oil returns to the skin, it softens and shines).
cfeb559d.st: Airtight at 18–22 °C, 7 days after the 2-day rest.
cfeb559d.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, shaoxing wine) · 3 Eggs (salted egg yolks, egg yolks) · 14 Sulphites (shaoxing wine).

c: Boil water; add sago; simmer 10 min, cover 10 min off heat until clear; rinse cold.
Blend 600 g mango with coconut milk, evaporated milk and sugar; chill.
Dice remaining mango; break pomelo into sacs.
Serve 180 ml base over 35 g sago in a chilled bowl; top with mango dice and pomelo.
9d6eb2fa.st: Chill 0–4 °C; base 2 days, assembled same day.

c: Blend pandan with water; squeeze through muslin; rest 2 h, use the dark sediment + 40 g juice (natural colour).
Whisk yolks and sugar; add coconut milk, oil and pandan; whisk in sifted flour and baking powder.
Whip whites with lemon juice; add sugar gradually to firm, glossy peaks.
Fold into the yolk batter in 3 additions; pour into an ungreased 23 cm tube tin; tap out air.
Bake 160 °C 50 min; invert immediately and cool fully upside down; release with a thin knife; cut 12.
63b03ca7.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (egg yolks, egg whites).

c: Blend pandan with water, strain; knead juice into flour to a soft, smooth dough (adjust water).
Chop palm sugar fine; steam coconut with salt and water 5 min.
Wrap 4 g palm sugar in 11 g dough; seal well (leaks burst in the pot).
Boil until floating + 1 min; roll in coconut while warm.
Mix; freeze in flat trays or blocks 8 h; shave fine in an ice shaver to order (120 g per bowl).
Mix flour, water and sugar; microwave or steam until translucent (as gyūhi); knead.
Roll on roasted soy flour (kinako); cut 1.5 cm cubes; coat.
Build: shaved milk ice, 30 g anko, 25 g injeolmi, 10 g condensed milk drizzle, 10 g kinako dust, almonds. Serve at once.
ea31d3f8.st: Milk ice blocks −18 °C, 2 weeks; injeolmi same day.
ea31d3f8.al: 6 Soybeans (soy flour) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, condensed milk) · 8 Nuts (almonds).
